question: To whom must a particular thing be given only after it has been tested for one year following prior accomplishment?
premises: Something is designated as to be given.
The recipient is one who has been previously accomplished.
That thing is to be tested for one year before giving.
inference: A thing is to be given to one previously accomplished only after testing it for one year.
uncertainties: Nature of the thing to be given remains unspecified
plain_english: It is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished, and only after it has been tested for one year.
